Digilife Rapidboil Portable Travel Kettle – Compact, Safe & Travel-Ready

The Digilife Rapidboil Portable Travel Kettle, Inbuilt Cable, Auto Cut-off, SUS 304, 300W Power, 400ml Capacity is designed for modern travelers, professionals, and students who need quick boiling anytime, anywhere. Whether you are staying in a hotel, hostel, office, or traveling long distances, this portable electric kettle ensures fast heating, safety, and convenience in a compact form.

Built with SUS 304 food-grade stainless steel, the Rapidboil Portable Travel offers durability, hygiene, and superior heat resistance. The 300W rapid heating technology allows you to boil water efficiently while consuming less power, making it ideal for travel and daily use.

Fast Boiling with 300W Rapidboil Technology

Equipped with 300W low-power rapid boil technology, this mini electric heats water quickly without overloading power sockets. The Digilife Rapidboil Portable Travel Kettle, Inbuilt Cable, Auto Cut-off, SUS 304, 300W Power, 400ml Capacity is perfect for preparing tea, coffee, instant noodles, soups, baby food, or warm water in just minutes.

Safe & Reliable Auto Cut-Off Protection

Safety is a priority with the Rapidboil Portable Travel Kettle. The built-in auto cut-off feature automatically turns off the once the water reaches boiling point, preventing overheating and dry boiling. This makes it a reliable and safe electric travel for everyday use.

Premium SUS 304 Stainless Steel Interior

The interior of this stainless steel travel is made from SUS 304 food-grade stainless steel, ensuring pure, odor-free, and healthy boiling. Unlike plastic kettles, it does not retain smell or taste, making it perfect for long-term usage.

Compact 400ml Capacity – Ideal for Travel

With a 400ml capacity, the is compact yet sufficient for personal use. Its lightweight design fits easily into backpacks, suitcases, or office desks, making it one of the best portable kettles for travel, office, and hostel rooms.

Inbuilt Power Cable for Easy Storage

The inbuilt cable design eliminates clutter and makes storage simple. No need to carry extra wires or adapters. This feature enhances portability and convenience, especially for frequent travelers.

Key Features & Benefits

  • ✔ Rapid boiling with 300W low-power consumption
  • ✔ Auto cut-off protection for enhanced safety
  • ✔ SUS 304 food-grade stainless steel interior
  • ✔ Compact 400ml capacity for personal use
  • ✔ Portable and lightweight travel-friendly design
  • ✔ Inbuilt cable for easy storage and portability
  • ✔ Ideal for travel, office, hostel, and hotel stays

Perfect for Multiple Uses

The Inbuilt Cable, Auto Cut-off, SUS 304, 300W Power, 400ml Capacity is suitable for boiling water for tea, coffee, instant noodles, soups, oats, and baby food. Its efficient heating and compact size make it a must-have mini electric kettle for daily convenience.

Why Choose ?

If you are looking for a reliable, safe, and efficient electric travel, offers the perfect solution. With premium materials, rapid heating, and safety features, this delivers consistent performance wherever you go.

Choose the for hassle-free boiling, modern design, and dependable quality. A smart choice for those who value convenience, safety, and performance in a compact electric kettle.
